entries.name: hunk-hg
entries.summary: Adds Mercurial support, so Hunk reviews an hg working copy the way it reviews a Git one.

entries.name: hunk-lens
entries.summary: Keeps the current split-diff line in view, and paints its context beside the review.

entries.name: hunk-adaptive-theme
entries.summary: Picks a Hunk theme to match your terminal background at startup.

entries.name: hunk-diff-context
entries.summary: Pins the selected file's complete diff in a sidebar pane, so it stays visible beside the review.

entries.name: hunk-exclude-files
entries.summary: Hides files matching configured glob rules from the review stream.

entries.name: hunk-file-order
entries.summary: Chooses the file order in Hunk reviews, including Lazygit's mixed order.

entries.name: hunk-less-search
entries.summary: less-style forward search across the review stream, with in-diff match marks.

entries.name: hunk-mark-as-reviewed
entries.summary: Marks hunks and files as reviewed, tracks progress in a review pane, and can hide what you've finished.

entries.name: hunk-notes-to-markdown
entries.summary: Yanks every review note into the clipboard as formatted Markdown with one key (Y).

entries.name: hunk-codeowners
entries.summary: Shows CODEOWNERS context for the current changeset and selected file.

entries.name: hunk-git-lite
entries.summary: Adds a git status pane with stage/unstage commands, so you can act on a review without leaving it.

entries.name: hunk-tutor
entries.summary: An interactive tour of Hunk, taught inside a practice review.

entries.name: hunk-commit
entries.summary: Marks hunks while you review, then stages, commits, or folds them into an earlier commit — in git or Jujutsu, leaving files on disk untouched.

entries.name: hunk-gh-review
entries.summary: Turns Hunk into a GitHub review client: browse and reply to PR threads, then submit notes as a review.

entries.name: hunk-commit-log
entries.summary: Reviews a branch commit by commit: the series beside the diff, the message above it, and keys to step between them.

entries.name: hunkydory
entries.summary: Exports a review's diffs and notes to Markdown and JSON, and re-imports comments from an export into a live session.
